name: pricing
title: Pricing
author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
description: Plan cards carrying price, billing note and per-plan CTA, optionally over a feature comparison. Variants: cards, cards-with-comparison.
docs: `price` is a string and is never computed: "$95/mo", "From $1,200", "Free" and "Let's talk" are all legitimate. The highlighted card opens a nested .dark scope rather than painting a literal, which is the fix for the bug that made ComparisonTable's highlighted column invisible.
